description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LeaveRequestCommentDao within the OrangeHRM system. It tests various data access object methods related to leave request comments, leave comments, and leave requests, including search, save, and retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDaoTest
classes.description: PHP unit test class for testing the LeaveRequestCommentDao methods related to leave request comments and leave comments in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, creating an instance of LeaveRequestCommentDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Tests the searchLeaveRequestComments method for retrieving leave request comments filtered by leave request ID, verifying correct count and order.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Tests saving a leave request comment, verifying the saved object's properties and assigned ID.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveRequestCommentsCount
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the count of leave request comments matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Tests fetching a LeaveRequest entity by ID, including handling of non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testSearchLeaveComment
methods.description: Tests searching for leave comments with filters, verifying count and order and the instance types.

methods.name: testSaveLeaveComment
methods.description: Tests saving a leave comment, validating properties and ID assignment.

methods.name: testGetSearchLeaveCommentsCount
methods.description: Tests the count retrieval for leave comments filtered by leave ID.

methods.name: testGetLeaveById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Leave entity by ID, including handling non-existing leave.
